context: Yumiko and Sho prepare a home bath night.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (設備/風呂/支払い/印刷/合計) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 正坊、お風呂が沸いたわよ。
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった!新しいお風呂、気持ちいい!
lines.en: Yay! The new bath feels great!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 新しい設備にして、良かったわね。
lines.en: Glad we got the new equipment.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お金、たくさんかかったの?
lines.en: Did it cost a lot of money?
lines.style: curious small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 支払いは、少しずつしているのよ。
lines.en: We're paying it off little by little.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: curious small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 合計は、紙に印刷してあるわ。
lines.en: The total is printed on paper.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お風呂の設備、大好きだよ!
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
